criteria.description: meeting_agenda.xlsx exists and is an openable native OOXML workbook.
The workbook has a Meeting agenda sheet and the required five-column table.
All three calendar events are present exactly once and rows are ordered by start time.
Each row preserves the source item, contact, start, end, and duration values.
The requested cells are native editable values with readable time number formats and no image substitute.
The solver-visible calendar input matches the immutable OfficeBench source hash.
